spans.s:
लल् ललति 1.
a. To sport; to loll.
(क, ङ) लालयते 10.
d. To desire.
to seek, to obtain; to sport.

लल (लः-ला-लं)
a. Sporting; wishing.

लाला (ला) 1.
f. Saliva.

लल-जिह्व (ह्वः-ह्वा-ह्वं)
a. Savage,
fierce.
m. A camel; a dog.

लल-दम्बु (म्बुः) 2.
m. Nerium odorum.

ललन (नं) 1.
n. Pleasure, play, pas-
time; lolling the tongue.
f. (ना)
A woman; a wanton one; the
tongue.
m. The
Sāl tree.

लालन (नं) 1.
n. Coaxing.

ललन्तिका (का) 1.
f. Necklace hang-
ing as low as the navel; lizard.

ललाक (कः) 1.
m. The penis.

ललाट (टं) 1.
n. The forehead.

ललाट-तट (टं) 1.
n. Idem.

ललाट-न्तप (पः) 1.
n. The sun.

ललाट-पट्ट (ट्टं) 1.
n. A tiara, a fil-
let; the forehead.

ललाट-फलक (कं) 1.
n. Open forehead.

ललाट-रेखा (खा) 1.
f. A line on the
forehead indicating long life; a
wrinkled brow; mark of a sect.

लला_टिका (का) 1.
f. An ornament
worn on the forehead; a mark
on it made with sandal.

लालाटिक (कः-की-कं)
a. Relating to
the forehead; vile.
m. f. An at-
tentive servant; an idler.
m.
Mode of embracing.

ललाम (मः-मा-मं)
a. Beautiful, charm-
ing.
n. A mark or sign; dignity;
a flag; a horn; a mane; a row.
f. (मी) An ear ornament.

ललामक (कं) 1.
n. Chaplet of flowers
placed over the forehead.

ललामन् (म) 5.
n. A mark or sign.

ललित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Wished; wan-
ton; lively; tremulous, slow;
destroyed.
n. A branch of femi-
nine action, languid signs.
f. A
woman; a wanton; musk.

लालित (तः-ता-तं)
p. Loved; coaxed.

लालप्यमान (नः-ना-नं)
a. Saying or
supplicating much.

लालष्यमान (नः-ना-नं)
a. Wishing to enjoy.

लालसा (सः-सा) 1.
m. f. Ardent de-
sire; regret; longing; dalliance.

लालसीक (कं) 1.
n. Sauce, gravy.

लालाभक्ष (क्षः) 1.
m. A hell.

लाला-मेह (हः) 1.
m. Passing mucous urine.

लाला-विष (षः) 1.
m. An insect whose
saliva is venomous, a spider.

लाला-स्राव (वः) 1.
m. A spider.

लालिक (कः) 1.
m. A buffalo.
f. (का)
An evasive reply.

लालित्य (त्यं) 1.
n. Gracefulness.

लालिन् (ली-लिनी-लि)
a. Coaxing.
m. A seducer.
f. A wanton.

लालुका (का) 1.
f. A sort of necklace.
